Why Nyxa put deposit limits inside the bet slip

Nyxa's product team explains why limits now sit one tap from the bet button.

By Partner Desk, Sponsored content team · 14/10/2026 · 2 min read

Share

This is a paid article. Nyxa paid for it and reviewed it before publication. It is advertising, not independent journalism.

Nyxa has moved its deposit-limit settings into the bet slip, so customers can check or lower a limit without leaving the bet they are about to place. In this partner piece, Nyxa's product team explains why limits now sit one tap from the bet button, and what changes for customers.

What changed

Until this update, limits lived in the account settings, three screens away from betting. Nyxa's own research found that most customers who set a limit did so when they opened their account and rarely looked at it again.

  • Your current deposit limit, and how much of it remains for the period, are now shown above the stake field.
  • A "Lower limit" link opens the setting directly from the bet slip.
  • Lowering a limit applies immediately; raising one still requires the standard seven-day wait.
  • Customers without a limit see a short prompt to set one, which can be dismissed.

Why put limits in the bet slip

The team's reasoning is that the bet slip is where decisions happen. Seeing the remaining amount at that moment turns a limit from a setting you forget into information you use.

During testing with a group of Australian customers, people who could see their remaining limit in the slip were more likely to adjust their stake to fit it, and more likely to lower the limit itself. Nyxa says it did not test any change that made limits harder to find or slower to apply.

How it fits the national rules

Under the National Consumer Protection Framework, every licensed wagering provider must offer deposit limits and prompt customers to set one. The rules set a minimum; they do not say where in an app the setting must sit. Nyxa's change goes beyond the minimum by making the limit visible each time a bet is placed.

SettingWhere to find itWhen it applies
Lower deposit limitBet slip or account settingsImmediately
Raise deposit limitAccount settingsAfter 7 days
Take a breakAccount settingsImmediately

Other safer-betting tools in the app

Nyxa customers can also download monthly activity statements, set reminders that show how long they have been logged in, and take a break from their account for a set period. A link to BetStop, the national self-exclusion register, sits in the same menu.

The takeaway

If you bet with Nyxa, update the app and look above the stake field the next time you place a bet. If the remaining amount surprises you, lower it then and there.
